panel.title: How To
panel.ctx:
Order

Order Header

The Order Header Tab defines the parameters of an Order. Changing the Organization, Business Partner, Warehouse, Date Promised, etc. changes these values on all the lines.

1 · Sales Order

Open Sales Order from the menu (⌂ → Sales), create a line or two, and press the Process button (§6) → Complete. Completion is not just a status flip: completeIt fans out into the shipment and invoice that follow it, in the SAME signed op-group.

Step 7 · Enter the order header

Open Sales Order (window 143) and click New record.
Business Partner: e.g. Joe Block. Choosing it fills Invoice Partner and Price List automatically (CalloutOrder.bPartner, logged).
Target Document Type: Standard Order.
Click Save.

Step 9 · Complete the order

Go back to the Order tab. Your order is still the selected record, so there is nothing to look up in the list.
The form shows the actions that are allowed now: Complete · Prepare · Void. Click Complete.

The status becomes Completed (CO). The change is stored as a signed entry, and the chain check passes (§CRUD process committed … to=CO verifyChain=ok). Reload the page and it is still CO.

Step 9 · Complete the order …

panel.title: How To
panel.ctx:
Order Line

Order Line

The Order Line Tab defines the individual line items that comprise an Order.

Step 8 · Add a line
Open the Order Line tab and click New record. You do not have to click Save on the header first: as in iDempiere, moving to another tab saves the record you were typing. If a required field is still empty, the header is not saved and you stay on it, with the field marked. The Order Line tab only ever lists the lines of the order you are on, including lines added during this session to other orders.
Product: e.g. Oak Tree. Choosing it fills the Price from the order's price list (61.75), the UOM (Each) and the Tax (Standard), as iDempiere does. Quantity: 2. Line Net Amount becomes 123.50.
Click Save.

panel.title: How To
panel.ctx:
订单

订单

The Order Header Tab defines the parameters of an Order

1 · 销售订单

从菜单（⌂ → 销售）打开销售订单，建一两行，然后按处理按钮（§6）→ 完成。完成不只是改变状态：completeIt 会在同一个已签名的操作组里，接着生成后面的出货单和发票。

Step 7 · Enter the order header

Open Sales Order (window 143) and click New record.
Business Partner: e.g. Joe Block. Choosing it fills Invoice Partner and Price List automatically (CalloutOrder.bPartner, logged).
Target Document Type: Standard Order.
Click Save.

Step 9 · Complete the order

Go back to the Order tab. Your order is still the selected record, so there is nothing to look up in the list.
The form shows the actions that are allowed now: Complete · Prepare · Void. Click Complete.

The status becomes Completed (CO). The change is stored as a signed entry, and the chain check passes (§CRUD process committed … to=CO verifyChain=ok). Reload the page and it is still CO.

What Complete creates depends on the document type, exactly as in iDempiere. A Standard Order creates nothing else on Complete: its shipment and invoice come later (iDempiere's Generate Shipments / Generate Invoices). A POS Order, Warehouse Order or Credit Order creates its shipment on Complete, and a POS or Credit Order also its invoice.

The form shows the actions that are allowed now: Complete · Prepare · Void. Click Complete.
